verse: I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come forth from Jacob, and a scepter will arise from Israel. He will crush the skulls of Moab and strike down all the sons of Sheth.
story: Balaam was hired to curse Israel, and instead, as the Spirit of God came upon him, he saw a king far down the road.

I see him, but not now, he says: the vision belongs to a distant day. A star will come out of Jacob and a scepter rise out of Israel, a ruler who defeats the enemies of God's people. The paid sorcerer ends up blessing the people he was bought to curse, and he goes home with nothing. God can turn the plans of the opposed into a promise. The star Balaam saw, Christians have long recognised in Christ.
Some promises are for a day you will not see. Trust them anyway, as Balaam saw and trusted the star.
theme: Advent: waiting, promise, the coming King
